title.narrative: South Asia Subregional Economic Cooperation Highway Improvement Project

description.narrative: The project will support capacity, quality, and safety improvements of the East-West Highway (EWH), which is the main domestic and international trade corridor of Nepal, and which forms part of the South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) corridor 4 linking Kathmandu to Dhaka and Chittagong through India. The project will (i) rehabilitate and widen about 87 kilometers (km) of the EWH between Kanchanpur and Kamala in southeastern Nepal; (ii) improve road safety, asset management, and gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) on the 1,027 km EWH; and (iii) strengthen the road safety and GESI capacity of road sector agencies. The project will promote economic growth and contribute to improving the competitiveness of Nepal's exporting industries by enhancing the efficiency of the transport system, strengthening national and regional connectivity, and improving the safety of the road network.

title.narrative: Reports and Recommendations of the President
Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 3722: 65% of contracts awarded and 47% disbursed as of 22 Apr 2025

Progress Toward Outcome: Civil works contracts for KK-01 and KK-02 signed on 25 June 2020 and has commenced the work from 29 October 2020. As of June 2023, the physical progress in KK-1 and KK-2 is 29.40% and 31.97% respectively, which gives the average physical progress of 30.78% against the time elapsed of about 89.04% against the original allocated time. As of June 2023, construction of PD-Office building has achieved 19% of physical progress. Road safety awareness programs is being implemented from December 2022 and planning to conclude the activity within December 2023.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52097/52097-001-apfs-en_3.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Jun 2018: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52097/52097-001-iee-en_1.pdf
Some results are in the Resettlement Plans | Jan 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52097/52097-001-rp-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/52097/52097-001-smr-en_7.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Civil works contracts for KK-01 and KK-02 signed on 25 June 2020 and has commenced the work from 29 October 2020. As of June 2023, the physical progress in KK-1 and KK-2 is 29.40% and 31.97% respectively, which gives the average physical progress of 30.78% against the time elapsed of about 89.04% against the original allocated time.
The road safety assessment of EW Highway was carried out by TA consultant and submitted the final report. The report was cleared by the DOR. The implementation of Road Safety construction work is being initiated from Q3 2023. The activity is being conducted and total of 1,104 (487-boys, 44.11% and 617-Girls, 55.89%) students of various schools were already provided with road safety awareness. The plan is to complete the whole activity by December 2023.
129 divisional and regional officers, engineers, administration, and data managers of all divisional and regional offices from seven Provinces trained on GESI Operational Guidelines. Among trainees, 29 (22.48%) were women and 100 (77.51%) were men officials.
Contract for construction of PD Office building was awarded on 24 January 2022 and commenced work from 10 April 2022. As of June 2023, construction of PD-Office building has achieved 19% of physical progress.
